_comment: Large binaries for OCT-FormatShift reproducibility, versioned as GitHub Release assets (not git blobs). The repo/release is PRIVATE: use scripts/fetch_oct_data.py (needs GH_TOKEN). For the ANONYMOUS submission, cite the public sources in the paper README instead of this release (it would de-anonymize). Bump the tag + this manifest together when the data changes.

oct_contender_npz.tar.role: FM/CNN per-eye contender npz (regenerates Fig 3 + Fig A3; committed VLM npz cover the VLM curves)

gleam.zip.role: raw GLEAM Spectralis B-scans (Fig 1 + full panel regeneration); single-center, gleam2026

goals.zip.role: raw GOALS Topcon B-scans (cross-vendor validity Fig A2b); MICCAI-2022, Baidu AI Studio comp/230

RETOUCH_part_aa.role: raw RETOUCH macular B-scans, tar part 1/2 (speckle calibration Fig A2a); MICCAI-2017, retouch.grand-challenge.org
